g.text: COMMON OCTOPUS
Octopus vulgaris
Role: BOSS · ambush, grapple, venom, ink · rocky shallows to 200 m · mantle 25 cm, arms to 1 m · crabs are its favourite food
1 · KEY · camouflaged on a rock
2 · TELL · rises, web spreads, eyes lock
3 · POUNCE · the web drops over you
Colour, texture and shape copy the rock. Look for the eye.
Body and arms gather, web stretches: move now.
Under the web: arms probe, then a venomous bite.
SIZE · real scale from the crab's eye (crab carapace 12 cm)
our crab · 12 cm
common octopus · arms ~1 m (up to 9 kg)
10 cm
PALETTE
skin · dark flush · suckers · camouflage · eye · ink
PHASES · TELL → WINDOW (tuned)
1 Hidden: spot the eye; lantern light shows the edge
2 Probe: arm tips search your hiding spot; cut or parry
3 Webover: rise 0.7 s → drop; dodge out sideways
Grabbed: 2 s to break free or drop a leg (autotomy)
Bite = venom: slows you more each second held
Hurt: inks (a decoy cloud, blinds you too) and jets off
Weak spots: arms (a cut arm stops grabbing), eye
Sources: Gonçalves & Costa 2021 Front. Mar. Sci. · ADW
(O. vulgaris) · Wikipedia (O. vulgaris, cephalopod ink)
